text_block_list.name: MC
text_block_list.text:
""The time has finally come!! The 
culmination of two years of "U.A.F."!!""

text_block_list.name: MC
text_block_list.text:
"The battleground where top-tier Umamusume 
athletes gather, having conquered the 
qualifiers with their staggering physical 
prowess!"

text_block_list.name: MC
text_block_list.text: "The finals are finally about to begin!!"

text_block_list.name: MC
text_block_list.text:
"The venue is packed with spectators 
eagerly awaiting the birth of the No. 1 
Athlete Umamusume!!"
(WOOOOOOOOOOH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: MC
text_block_list.text:
"Now, feast your eyes!! Upon the ultimate 
festival brought to you by the supreme 
athlete Umamusume!!"

text_block_list.name: Stream Viewer A
text_block_list.text:
“—Hey, who do you think's gonna take the 
championship? My bet's on Elfi for sure!”

text_block_list.name: Stream Viewer B
text_block_list.text:
No, no, it's gotta be <chrname>!! Her races are 
amazing too, you know? She's a true 
top-tier athlete!

text_block_list.name: Stream Viewer C
text_block_list.text:
—Aww, I wanted to cheer for her in 
person~! The lottery odds for spectator 
tickets were way too crazy~!!

text_block_list.name: Stream Viewer D
text_block_list.text:
"Well, nothing we can do about it! I'll 
just send my good vibes to my fave from 
right here!"

text_block_list.name: PA Announcer
text_block_list.text:
“—And now, the Athlete's Oath. 
Representing Tracen Academy, Winning 
Ticket. Please proceed.”

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Yes, sir!!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
—We solemnly swear!!! We, the 
competitors!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Demonstrate the mind and body you have 
forged to the fullest!! And show respect 
to all sports!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Fair and square, giving it our absolute 
all!! Never letting our hard-earned sweat 
go in vain!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
With passion, with joy, and with 
brilliance!!! We shall vie for the 
pinnacle!!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Right here and nooooow!!! I so solemnly 
sweeeeeeeaaaar!!!!
(WOOOOOOOOOOH!!)

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
—Looks like <chrname>-san is in peak condition and 
ready to dazzle as well!!

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
"However, I won't lose either!! Consider 
me completely different from the me of 
last time!!"

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
Now, to everyone in this venue, and to 
everyone watching the stream, let us show 
them clearly and proudly!!

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
Witness the brilliance of an athlete 
Umamusume!!!
